boundary_condition: Apply this to the booked room's smoking status only; do not infer broader preferences about hotel-wide smoking areas, balconies, neighborhoods, or transportation.
condition: When the synthetic user is selecting, comparing, or booking a hotel room and smoking status can be specified or confirmed.
default_action: Choose, request, or confirm a non-smoking hotel room by default.
exception_condition: If no non-smoking room is available for the otherwise suitable stay, do not automatically book a smoking room; ask whether to look for alternatives or get explicit confirmation before proceeding.
name: Default to non-smoking hotel rooms
rationale: Multiple independent hotel dialogues request or confirm "non-smoking" as a room feature. The examples support a reusable hotel-room default for non-smoking status, while dates, prices, bed types, and other one-off constraints remain outside this habit.

source_evidence.contribution: User stated, "I only prefer the two queen beds and non-smoking".
User specified "Queen size bed and non-smoking".
User asked, "Okay and is it non-smoking?"

source_examples.user_utterance: Yes, I only prefer the two queen beds and non-smoking, and it should be around $80 or below.
